A man sent a signal from inside a dream.
In 1975 Alan Worsley realised he was dreaming and moved his eyes in a pattern agreed with Keith Hearne. The recording showed it: widely credited as the first message from a lucid dream.

This lizard cycles through sleep every 80 seconds.
Bearded dragons alternate between two sleep states, like deep and REM sleep, in cycles of about 80 seconds; ours last about 90 minutes.
